name: Sundrel Post 188 Original
description: This listing is an anorthosite-block quench pit listed with peak temperature 859 degrees Celsius, chamber capacity 1078 litres, heat up 482 minutes. Its remaining stated figures are cycles before relining 1884 cycles, unit price set after acceptance, heat source gas-fired. Every one of them is quoted from the same six axes the other listings in this category are described on.
